description: as seastate_2d_phase9_width (one level of 100 m along a 600 m wide fjord, G 1 1) with the FAS coarse-grid correction (A 758 2 4, Phase 9): every 2 iterations, level 0 is solved as a grid of its own for 4 iterations with tau = r_c(R N) - R r on the covered cells and the difference of its own and the composite residual on the others, and the change is prolonged into the patches; tight convergence (A 708 1e-5, A 709 100) for several corrections. Validation in Dropbox SEASTATE/validation/45_fas.
covers: seastate_amr fas (residuals, tau, coarse solve, prolongation)
seastate_implicit residual mode and FAS source
